verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a commerce platform like Square, but the evidence shows no product-native feature for creating automations that run on their own. Webhooks, the Webhook Subscriptions API, SDKs and the MCP server are developer building blocks a developer could use to build automations, not an automation capability itself. 'Schedule and pay your team' refers to staff scheduling, an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
